Why does GameStop pay so little for your old games?
In fiscal 2018, GameStop's 10-K showed a 43.4% gross margin on pre-owned and value products versus 8.5% on new video game hardware.
Our math: on $100 of those sales, about $43 was gross profit, before stores, staff and unsold stock.
In the quarter ended Aug 1, 2026, pre-owned and refurbished sales were $170.7 million, 21.6% of net sales; total net sales fell from $6.01 billion in fiscal 2021 to $3.63 billion in fiscal 2025.
Sources: GameStop fiscal 2018 Form 10-K, fiscal 2025 and Q2 fiscal 2026 results releases.
News and education, not financial advice.
